remarks: OPPORTUNITY KNOCKS!! This quaint Ranch is located in the desirable Pemberwick neighborhood of Greenwich surrounded $1M+ homes and across from the Byram River with tranquil water views. The possibilities are endless, whether a condo alternative with existing room for expansion by enclosing screened porch and finishing off 1/2 of the huge garage or an addition for which architectural plans are attached or build new!! Central air and natural gas heat already exist. Not in a flood plane and convenient to Greenwich schools; minutes from Greenwich Ave & Westchester towns; close to parks, beaches & trains and all of Greenwich amenities. Not to be missed! House being sold "as is".
